title: Let admins refund an order
body: Adds POST /orders/:id/refund so support can refund a paid order in full without editing the database.

labels.note: POST /orders/:id/refund is registered with requireUser only. Cancel, the other admin action, also has requireAdmin, so any signed-in member can refund any paid order in full.
Commit 3 drops requireAdmin from the refund route again. The fixed defect is back, so it is a new finding with one new inline comment.
